name: Cisco ASA
description: Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance. VPN, packet capture, AAA/RADIUS, NAT, routing, failover, and ASP diagnostics.
notes: Use 'terminal pager 0' if output stops at a pager prompt.
Run 'terminal monitor' in an SSH session to see debug output there.
Debug output can be CPU intensive. Every debug runbook includes cleanup commands.

categories.name: Packet capture
categories.description: Capture traffic on an interface, host pair, subnet, ACL, or tunnel.

categories.name: Connectivity
categories.description: Ping, traceroute, route lookup, ARP, and packet-tracer.

categories.name: VPN / IPsec
categories.description: AnyConnect, IKEv2, IPsec, and tunnel diagnosis.

categories.name: AAA / RADIUS
categories.description: RADIUS, TACACS+, AAA server tests, and authentication debugs.

categories.description: NAT translations, connections, and policy path checks.

categories.name: Routing

workflows.title: Packet capture — host to host
workflows.summary: Create a 32 MB circular capture on an interface, generate traffic, then display the packets.

steps.command: capture TSTCAP interface {iface} buffer bytes 33554432 match ip host {src} host {dst}
steps.note: Creates a 32 MB circular buffer named TSTCAP.

steps.instruction: Generate the traffic, then run the display command.

steps.note: Shows the path and NAT decisions for packet 1.

cleanup.note: Stops the capture and frees the buffer.

notes: Use a larger buffer if the traffic burst is high.
The capture name is fixed (TSTCAP) so cleanup is predictable.

workflows.title: Packet capture — TCP or UDP port
workflows.summary: Capture a single application flow between two hosts and one port.

steps.command: capture TSTCAP interface {iface} buffer bytes 33554432 match {proto} host {src} host {dst} eq {port}

notes: For a range of ports, use an ACL capture instead.

workflows.title: Packet capture — subnet to subnet
workflows.summary: Capture all traffic between two subnets using ASA wildcard masks.

steps.command: capture TSTCAP interface {iface} buffer bytes 33554432 match ip {srcnet} {srcmask} {dstnet} {dstmask}

steps.instruction: Generate traffic, then display the buffer.

notes: This can fill quickly on busy segments. Narrow to a host pair when possible.

workflows.title: Packet capture — with a temporary ACL
workflows.summary: Build a temporary ACL for a protocol and host pair, attach it to a capture, then remove both.
steps: access-list TSTCAP_ACL extended permit {proto} host {src} host {dst}
capture TSTCAP interface {iface} buffer bytes 33554432 match access-list TSTCAP_ACL

steps.instruction: Generate traffic, then inspect the capture.

notes: Useful for ESP (protocol 50) when a simple host match is not enough.

workflows.title: Connectivity check
workflows.summary: Ping, trace, route lookup, and ARP lookup for a target.

workflows.title: Packet-tracer — TCP flow
workflows.summary: Simulate a TCP flow through ACLs, NAT, routing, and inspection without sending traffic.
notes: Read the result from the bottom up: NAT, route, ACL, inspection, then the final action.

workflows.title: Packet-tracer — ICMP echo
workflows.summary: Check whether an ICMP echo request would be allowed and routed.

workflows.title: VPN session inventory
workflows.summary: Summarize AnyConnect and site-to-site sessions, then inspect details.

workflows.title: VPN user lookup
workflows.summary: Find a user's AnyConnect session and related authentication log lines.

workflows.title: IKEv2 debugs — connection failures
workflows.summary: Enable IKEv2 protocol and platform debugs, reproduce the failure, then inspect logging.

steps.note: Shows debug and log output in this SSH session.

steps.instruction: Attempt the VPN connection now, then inspect the log.

notes: IKEv2 debug flags are global, not per-peer.
If you are connected over SSH, use 'show logging' or ASDM to read the output.

workflows.title: IPsec debugs — tunnel and SA issues
workflows.summary: Inspect IPsec security associations and enable IPsec debug output for a peer.

steps.instruction: Send traffic through the tunnel, then check the SAs and logs.

workflows.title: AnyConnect debugs — connection and login
workflows.summary: Enable AnyConnect/WebVPN debugs and inspect session establishment.

steps.instruction: Reconnect the AnyConnect client, then read the output.

workflows.title: RADIUS debugs — all users
workflows.summary: Enable RADIUS debugging for every authentication attempt and watch the output.

steps.instruction: Trigger the authentication attempt, then inspect the log.

notes: This is global. Use the single-user runbook when many users are authenticating.

workflows.title: RADIUS debugs — one user
workflows.summary: Filter RADIUS debugging to a single username and find that user's log lines.

steps.instruction: Have the user authenticate now, then inspect the log.

notes: If this ASA release rejects 'debug radius user', use the all-users runbook.

workflows.title: Test RADIUS authentication
workflows.summary: Check server reachability, inspect the AAA group, and run a test authentication.

steps.note: The ASA prompts for the test password; it is not stored by TSTerm.

notes: Confirm the server group tag exactly with 'show aaa-server'.

workflows.title: NAT and connection lookup
workflows.summary: Look up translations and connections for a source, then trace the flow.

workflows.title: Routing protocol status
workflows.summary: Inspect routes plus OSPF, EIGRP, and BGP neighbors in one pass.
notes: Some commands are absent when that routing protocol is not enabled.

workflows.title: Failover and HA health
workflows.summary: Check failover state, history, and monitored interfaces.
notes: Not all platforms support every failover subcommand.

workflows.title: System health snapshot
workflows.summary: Version, CPU, memory, connections, ASP drops, and recent logs.

workflows.title: ASP drop investigation
workflows.summary: Inspect the ASP drop counters and the paths that are dropping packets.

workflows.title: DHCP debugs
workflows.summary: Inspect DHCP bindings and enable DHCP daemon packet debugging.

steps.instruction: Renew the client lease, then inspect the log.
